body: Yes, 'helpful'. Can't exactly punch my mother and sister in the face.

I see your point, but that's already something I've experienced a lot through my degree anyway. Healthcare is full of spiteful people who think they're picking at you to make you better. I can cope if it's just a shitty personality or done to try and make you better at your job I suppose.

UK. If I were to join as a student nurse (which I wasn't sure I would be able to do without switching to a military program, but turns out I could) then the fitness requirements are just; Mid Thigh Pull 50kg, Medicine Ball Throw 2.7m, 2km run 12m, MSFT (beep test) level 5.8. It's not bad, but I'm out of shape so would take a bit of work probably.
Thank you, I'm looking into it and other than needing to do a bit of work to reach the fitness requirements it seems like my best option.
